programme.title: Darah Satria
programme.desc: Berpangkat Leftenan Muda, Ariff terlibat dalam operasi memburu komunis di hutan. Mempunyai seorang isteri bernama Rafidah, namun terpaksa ditinggalkannya bersama ibu bapanya kerana sibuk menjalankan operasi. Dalam satu operasi menentang komunis, Ariff bersama anak buahnya melalui kesukaran yang menyebabkan Ariff mengalami kecederaan manakala salah seorang daripada mereka terkorban.

programme.title: Tipu Kanan Tipu Kiri
programme.desc: Rudy, seorang jejaka tampan yang memiliki segalanya, Isterinya bernama Wulan, seorang penyanyi terkenal di Indonesia. Malangnya dalam syarat kontrak rakamannya, Wulan tidak dibenarkan untuk berkahwin. Untuk menyembunyikan perkahwinan mereka, Rudy dan Wulan berpindah ke Malaysia. Pelbagai kejadian lucu berlaku akibat kekeliruan dan suasana kelam kabut yang terjadi akibat penipuan mereka berdua.

programme.title: Leftenan Adnan
programme.desc: Adnan memutuskan untuk menjadi seorang tentera dalam pasukan Askar Melayu setelah dikunjungi anggota tentera British yang datang ke kampungnya untuk merekrut lebih ramai anak tempatan. Tidak direstui keluarga, Adnan nekad untuk mengikuti latihan ketenteraan di Port Dickson. Perjuangan Leftenan Adnan dalam mempertahankan Tanah Melayu memberikan inspirasi kepada ramai anak muda tempatan.

programme.title: Estet
programme.desc: Mengisahkan para pekerja estet Cinta Manis yang bakal bertarung dengan kumpulan estet Red Cobra dalam satu perlawanan bola sepak yang sudah 20 tahun tidak diadakan. Farid dan Shashi, dua pekerja estet yang berkawan sejak kecil, menjadi harapan pekerja estet yang lain untuk menyelamatkan penindasan yang dilakukan oleh kerani estet, Pooniah. Seorang gadis cantik bernama Geetha tertarik hati dengan Farid dan Shashi. Sesi latihan dikendalikan oleh Subramaniam iaitu bapa Geetha yang dilantik sebagai jurulatih. Ayah kepada Shashi, Apaa, adalah pemain bola yang sangat mahir, tetapi telah berlaku insiden semasa perlawanan bola sepak estet itu dahulu yang mana kakinya patah diterjah oleh Junna, seorang samseng estet yang sengaja ingin menamatkan karier Apaa atas upahan Pooniah 20 tahun yang lalu. Berjayakah Farid dan Shashi serta kawan-kawannya membebaskan pekerja estet Cinta Manis daripada penindasan Pooniah?

programme.title: Pecah
programme.desc: Empat orang lelaki berjaya merompak sebuah bank tetapi malangnya salah seorang daripada mereka cedera dan terpaksa dirawat di hospital. Pada masa yang sama, seorang wanita yang menjaga orang tua di sebuah rumah orang tua, membawa salah seorang penghuninya ke hospital yang sama untuk mendapatkan rawatan. Apa yang berlaku kemudiannya ialah pembongkaran demi pembongkaran agenda tersembunyi, di samping penyiasatan daripada pihak polis pada masa yang sama.

programme.title: Tuah
programme.desc: Datuk Shaari dan Shahira diselamatkan oleh seorang lelaki yang mendakwa bahawa dirinya Hang Tuah, seorang pahlawan Melayu di abad ke-15. Meragui kisahnya, mereka membawanya melakukan pemeriksaan fizikal dan mental di hospital, lama-kelamaan Shahira mula mempercayainya. Tuah secara ajaibnya telah dibawa ke zaman moden dan mula mempelajari apa yang terjadi pada masa lalu. Akhirnya, Tuah pulang semula ke tempat asalnya dan mula membetulkan keadaan.

programme.title: Aku Ada Kau Ada ???
programme.desc: Seorang pelajar bernama Nordin Ahmad yang ingin kelihatan cool di mata orang lain. Walau bagaimanapun, setiap kali Nordin menjadi tumpuan, dia akan menjadi panik dan muntah. Sementara itu, Aziz pula seorang pelajar yang perasan popular yang selalu menyakat Nordin. Tina pula seorang pelajar yang baru bertukar ke kolej mereka untuk menjalani sebuah program khas untuk mengatasi sikap panas baran yang ditawarkan oleh Dr. Zida.

programme.title: Usop Wilcha Mehghonjang Makhluk Muzium
programme.desc: Mengisahkan sebuah muzium yang ingin mengadakan satu pameran Hantu-Hantu Dunia untuk menarik minat pengunjung. Tanpa disedari, penganjuran pameran ini mempunyai matlamat tersendiri. Melalui perancangan licik sekumpulan pengamal ilmu hitam dari Romania, pameran ini sebenarnya ingin menghidupkan kembali Raja Dracula. Mengikut kepercayaan kumpulan ini, Raja Dracula akan dapat hidup kembali dengan mendapatkan darah manusia dari setiap benua.

programme.title: Anak Sarawak
programme.desc: Pegawai Daerah, Azam Wasli berusaha untuk membangunkan Laka, sebuah kawasan terpencil di Sarawak. Pelbagai rintangan dihadapinya yang ingin menyatukan puak di kawasan itu. Azam turut menemui cinta bersama Mei Ling, seorang wartawan - tetapi dia diambil sebagai tebusan untuk menggugat posisi Azam. Insiden itu membawa kepada perjumpaan semula antara dua saudara.

programme.title: Jiran
programme.desc: Mengisahkan Ramlan sekeluarga yang baru berpindah di sebuah kawasan perumahan. Namun, Ramlan melarang isteri dan anaknya Tina daripada bergaul dengan jiran-jiran mereka di situ. Ramlan sendiri beranggapan bahawa dengan berlaku sombong terhadap orang, dirinya akan dipandang mulia. Kesombongan Ramlan itu akhirnya menyusahkan dirinya sendiri apabila berlaku satu insiden yang melibatkan kehilangan Tina.

programme.title: Air Zam Zam Untuk Mak
programme.desc: Mak Jah, seorang guru Al-Quran yang telah menabung dengan Tabung Haji selama 30 tahun demi cita-cita menunaikan haji. Namun sejak tinggal bersama anaknya, Suhaili, dia semakin risau melihat menantunya Borhan yang terlalu taksub mengejar kekayaan. Tanpa pengetahuan keluarga, Borhan menerima rasuah dan akhirnya ditangkap, menyebabkan semua akaunnya dibekukan. Selepas Borhan dibebaskan, Mak Jah jatuh sakit. Dalam keadaan lemah, dia merayu agar Borhan dan Suhaili menggantikannya ke tanah suci, dengan satu permintaan sahajapulanglah dengan membawa air zam-zam untuknya. programme.title: Jubah Dari Mekah

programme.title: Melukis Luka

programme.title: Aku Bukan Gila

programme.title: Ada Apa Dengan Dosa

Dalam perjalanan tersebut, dia dibantu oleh Khaliq dan mula mengenali erti keluarga, agama serta berdepan dengan dosa silam yang menghantui ibu bapanya.

programme.title: Story of Kunning Palace ((100万个约定之宁安如梦))
programme.desc: Jiang Xue-ning Bai Lu went to great lengths to become the Empress. But she was forced to take her own life in the palace. Fast forward to the present, and Jiang Xue-nings wish is to stay away from power struggles and control her destiny. However, she still somehow enters the palace as a study partner and becomes Master Xie Weis Zhang Linghe pupil. While learning from Xie Wei, Jiang Xue-ning plots to prevent Yan Lin Zhou Junwei from getting involved in the coming-of-age incident. First Princess Shen Zhi-yi Liu Xening does not hesitate to go down the road to making peace by marriage. To save her buddy Shen Zhi-yi, Jiang Xue-ning goes with Xie Wei to the north to deal with the State of Yue. While overcoming difficulties, Xie Wei does not mind getting hurt as he protects Jiang Xue-ning. The duo gradually have affectionate feelings for each other. However, an even more evil conspiracy gradually surfaces, and it astonishingly points to the truth about the Lord Pingnan incident from twenty years ago. Jiang Xue-ning and Xie Wei eventually team up to uncover the truth from yesteryear. Jiang Xue-ning also uses love to influence Xie Wei. The couple eventually find happiness. (江宁·白卢为成为皇帝做了很大的努力.但她被迫在宫殿中自杀.快速前进到现在,江宁的愿望是远离权力斗争,控制她的命运.然而,她仍然是某种程度上进入宫殿作为学习伙伴,成为伟先生的学生.在学习时,江宁阴谋阻止延周军在成年事件中参与.通过遵循江宁和徐伟战略,延们设法保持活着.在成年危机后,江宁无意地卷入了王朝的阴谋与伟王主张强的反抗.然而,她和伟王妃在成年后,最终会在伟王朝的两人之间进行和平,并最终无法在两人之间进行更深入的关系.但在两年后,)

programme.title: The Ahistoric Grandpa Cooking Show Sr.5 ((阿爷厨房 Sr.5))
programme.desc: Li Jiading Master Ding, the tough guy, is undoubtedly a master of martial arts, but it turns out his culinary skills are equally impressive! Master Ding has set up Master Dings Kitchen, partnering with the discerning food connoisseur Tan Yuying. Each episode takes viewers on a sourcing trip for their favorite ingredients, and Master Ding personally cooks a variety of his signature dishes, soups, and desserts, offering a taste of nostalgic Cantonese cuisine! How to cook authentic traditional salt-baked chicken at an affordable price? How to control the heat and time when steaming fish? In autumn and winter, many people love fragrant claypot rice, especially the crispy rice crust. But have you ever seen claypot rice with crispy rice on both sides? Watch Master Ding show off his skills and teach you how! (李建丁师,坚强的老师丁,无疑是武术的士,但他厨艺技巧也令人印象深刻!丁师与精明的食品熟练者坦尤宁合作建立了士丁厨房.每集都带着观众去寻找他们最喜欢的食材,丁师亲自做各种特色的菜,和甜点,提供怀旧的堪敦式美食!如何以负担得起的价格做真实的传统烤?如何控制鱼时的热量和时间?秋冬,许多人喜欢香水米,特别是脆的米皮.但你有没有见过士丁的米米两侧都显示了米米的米技巧吗?看看看!)

programme.title: Cause Of Death (死亡原因)
programme.desc: Newly appointed female forensic pathologist Dr. Ching Chi-yan Hera Chan has always been inspired by Dr. Lam Sum Willie Wai. And ever since Chi-yan was a kid, she has aspired to join the Forensic Pathology Service. However, she is sidelined by her boss Dr. Lam Sum after starting her new job. Lam Sum and his ex-wife Ko Shuk-han Alice Wong, RCU Senior Inspector, cannot stand each other. Their paths cross again as their daughter Lam Suet-lui runs away from home. Chi-yan gains Lam Sums approval with her industrious work attitude and forms a bond with police officer Ko Chun Mark Ma. The three of them gradually become a well-coordinated crime-busting trio. After experiencing heartbreak and unemployment, Chi-yans buddy Sin Pui-ka Jinny Ng becomes a local news reporter. She and seasoned reporter Tsim Pak-yu Nicholas Yuen evolve from playful rivals to supportive partners. Just as Chi-yans career is progressing well, she hears the news of her good friend Pui-kas death. She is determined to uncover the truth and speak out for the deceased! (新任命的女性法医病理学家程志扬·赫拉·陈博士一直受到Lam Sum Willie Wai博士的启发。自从Chiyan博士还是个孩子以来,她一直渴望加入法医病理学处。然而,她在其上司Lam Sum博士开始新工作后被其上司Lam Sum博士所排挤。Lam Sum和他的前妻Ko Shuk-han Alice Wong, RCU高级检查员,不能站在一起。她们的女儿Lam Suet-lui离家出走,她们的道路又再次交叉。Chiyan 得到Lam Suet-lui的认可,她的工作态度是勤奋的,她与警官Ko Chun Mark Ma建立了联系。她们中的三个人逐渐成为精心协调的犯罪破坏三者。在经历了心脏病和失业之后,Chiyans兄弟Sin Pui-ka Jinny Ng成为当地新闻记者。她和时髦的记者Tsim Pak-yu Nicolas Yuen从玩耍的对手发展到支持的合作伙伴。正如Chiyan的事业正在进步一样,她听到好朋友死亡的消息。她决心揭露真相并说出死亡的真相。)

programme.desc: Qi Sizhe becomes Director of Forensic Medicine for the Hecheng Criminal Police Unit, reunites with Han Feng, and investigates the truth behind his girlfriend Yu Feis death from the drug Original Diamond three years earlier. A series of nightclub attacks, cocoon murders, medical-school specimen crimes, insurance frauds, and silencing killings all point to a new narcotic and a drug-manufacturing ring. Qi Sizhe, Han Feng, and their team uncover Professor Wu Yongchang as the mastermind and Yu Feis true killer. Police raid the drug factory, arrest Wu and the traffickers, and close the new Original Diamond case. programme.title: Gourmet Express ((美食新闻周报))
programme.desc: Hong Kong brings together global cuisines, and its unique dishes and down-to-earth fare have captured the close attention of discerning food lovers! Food hosts and presenters such as Icy Wong,Snowy Choi,Carmen Ngai,Carmaney Wong , Jessica Liu , Gillian Ng keep up with the latest food news and deals, delving into the stories behind the flavors. Gathering firsthand information on popular eateries across various platforms, the hosts personally line up and taste the food, providing genuine reviews. Even takeout-only eateries with no dine-in option are in high demandwhat are the must-try picks? Running a food business inevitably comes with its own mix of sweet, sour, bitter, and spicy experiences. The production team follows the proprietors through their busy day, from sourcing ingredients and preparing materials to opening for business, uncovering the stories behind the flavors. (香港汇集全球菜,其独特的菜和精致的菜吸引了富有挑的爱好者! 食物主持人和主持人如Icy Wong,Snowy Choi,Carmen Ngai,Carmaney Wong,Jessica Liu,Gillian Ng跟上最新的食物新闻和交易,深入了解味道背后的故事. 收集了各种平台的流行餐厅的第一手信息,主持人亲自排列并品尝食物,提供了真实的评论.即使没有餐饮选择的餐厅也很受欢迎.)

programme.title: Vital Lifeline ((最强生命线))
programme.desc: Urban dwellers often experience a hectic pace of life and high levels of stress, making them more susceptible to health problems. The Strongest Lifeline helps you unravel the secrets to good health. To start, the program features a four-episode series on common urban pain issues, covering headaches, shoulder and neck pain, back pain, and joint pain. Each episode invites medical experts to explain the causes of these conditions, as well as physical therapists and exercise specialists to teach appropriate exercises. With the growing trend of integrating Eastern and Western medicine, even American swimming champion Michael Phelps uses cupping therapy to relieve pain. Therefore, each episode also includes traditional Chinese medical diagnosis, complemented by treatments such as acupuncture, cupping, and the Sanfu herbal patch therapy, which is especially suitable during the hottest days of summer. In addition, Chinese medicine practitioners share recipes for nourishing soups, all of which can help regulate and improve your health. (城市居民往往经历着繁忙的生活和高度压力,这使他们更容易受到健康问题的影响。最强的生命线帮助你解开健康的秘密。首先,该方案在常见的城市疼痛问题上有四大系列,包括头痛、肩部和颈部疼痛、背部疼痛和联合疼痛。每集都邀请医疗专家解释这些病症的原因,以及物理治疗师和锻炼专家进行适当的锻炼。随着东西方医学结合的趋势日益增长,甚至美国游泳冠军迈克尔·菲尔普斯也使用杯式疗法来缓解疼痛。因此,每集都包括传统的中国医学诊断,辅之以针线、杯子和Sanfu草药补丁疗法等疗法,这些疗法在最热的夏季特别合适。此外,中国医药从业人员分享了营养汤的食谱,所有这些都有助于调节和改善你的健康。)

programme.title: Story of Kunning Palace ((100万个约定之宁安如梦))
programme.desc: Jiang Xue-ning Bai Lu went to great lengths to become the Empress. But she was forced to take her own life in the palace. Fast forward to the present, and Jiang Xue-nings wish is to stay away from power struggles and control her destiny. However, she still somehow enters the palace as a study partner and becomes Master Xie Weis Zhang Linghe pupil. While learning from Xie Wei, Jiang Xue-ning plots to prevent Yan Lin Zhou Junwei from getting involved in the coming-of-age incident. By following Jiang Xue-ning and Xie Weis strategy, the Yans manage to stay alive. After the coming-of-age crisis, Jiang Xue-ning unwittingly gets embroiled in the imperial court crackdown on Lord Pingnan rebels scheme. She and Zhang Zhe Wang Xingyue venture into enemy territory. At the critical moment, Jiang Xue-ning uses her body to shield arrows for Zhang Zhe. But the duo eventually cannot stay together. Hostile the State of Yue launches an invasion. First Princess Shen Zhi-yi Liu Xening does not hesitate to go down the road to making peace by marriage. To save her buddy Shen Zhi-yi, Jiang Xue-ning goes with Xie Wei to the north to deal with the State of Yue. While overcoming difficulties, Xie Wei does not mind getting hurt as he protects Jiang Xue-ning. The duo gradually have affectionate feelings for each other. However, an even more evil conspiracy gradually surfaces, and it astonishingly points to the truth about the Lord Pingnan incident from twenty years ago. Jiang Xue-ning and Xie Wei eventually team up to uncover the truth from yesteryear. Jiang Xue-ning also uses love to influence Xie Wei. The couple eventually find happiness. (江宁·白卢为成为皇帝做了很大的努力.但她被迫在宫殿中自杀.快速前进到现在,江宁的愿望是远离权力斗争,控制她的命运.然而,她仍然是某种程度上进入宫殿作为学习伙伴,成为伟先生的学生.在学习时,江宁阴谋阻止延周军在成年事件中参与.通过遵循江宁和徐伟战略,延们设法保持活着.在成年危机后,江宁无意地卷入了王朝的阴谋与伟王主张强的反抗.然而,她和伟王妃在成年后,最终会在伟王朝的两人之间进行和平,并最终无法在两人之间进行更深入的关系.但在两年后,)

programme.title: Story of Kunning Palace ((100万个约定之宁安如梦))
programme.desc: Jiang Xue-ning Bai Lu went to great lengths to become the Empress. But she was forced to take her own life in the palace. Fast forward to the present, and Jiang Xue-nings wish is to stay away from power struggles and control her destiny. However, she still somehow enters the palace as a study partner and becomes Master Xie Weis Zhang Linghe pupil. While learning from Xie Wei, Jiang Xue-ning plots to prevent Yan Lin Zhou Junwei from getting involved in the coming-of-age incident. By following Jiang Xue-ning and Xie Weis strategy, the Yans manage to stay alive. After the coming-of-age crisis, Jiang Xue-ning unwittingly gets embroiled in the imperial court crackdown on Lord Pingnan rebels scheme. She and Zhang Zhe Wang Xingyue venture into enemy territory. At the critical moment, Jiang Xue-ning uses her body to shield arrows for Zhang Zhe. But the duo eventually cannot stay together. Hostile the State of Yue launches an invasion. First Princess Shen Zhi-yi Liu Xening does not hesitate to go down the road to making peace by marriage. To save her buddy Shen Zhi-yi, Jiang Xue-ning goes with Xie Wei to the north to deal with the State of Yue. While overcoming difficulties, Xie Wei does not mind getting hurt as he protects Jiang Xue-ning. The duo gradually have affectionate feelings for each other. However, an even more evil conspiracy gradually surfaces, and it astonishingly points to the truth about the Lord Pingnan incident from twenty years ago. Jiang Xue-ning and Xie Wei eventually team up to uncover the truth from yesteryear. Jiang Xue-ning also uses love to influence Xie Wei. The couple eventually find happiness. (江宁·白卢为成为皇帝做了很大的努力.但她被迫在宫殿中自杀.快速前进到现在,江宁的愿望是远离权力斗争,控制她的命运.然而,她仍然是某种程度上进入宫殿作为学习伙伴,成为伟先生的学生.在学习时,江宁阴谋阻止延周军在成年事件中参与.通过遵循江宁和徐伟战略,延们设法保持活着.在成年危机后,江宁无意地卷入了王朝的阴谋与伟王主张强的反抗.然而,她和伟王妃在成年后,最终会在伟王朝的两人之间进行和平,并最终无法在两人之间进行更深入的关系.但在两年后,)

Leung-sing keeps creating fake news just to benefit himself. He clashes with righteous policewoman Sung Hoi-yan Priscilla Wong, causing both of them to lose their jobs. With the support of her uncle Ming Kwan-ngai KK Cheung, Hoi-yan becomes a private investigator. Leung-sing is forced to help Hoi-yan with her investigation activities as Hoi-yan catches him using his mystical power to peep at goddess Ming Cheuk-kei Zoie Tam. Gold digger Tong Mei-fun Kamen Kong is cruelly harassed as rich clan heir Tsui Tsun-wai Daniel Chau and she become foes. Mei-fun forgives Tsun-wai and offers to help him as Tsun-wai gets into a difficult situation. Leung-sing becomes increasingly arrogant as he uses to his mystical power to solve cases. Meanwhile, Hoi-yan shockingly finds out Kwan-ngais real character. Leung-sing faces the danger of exhausting his mystical power and becoming a rat as he helps Hoi-yan. (柳亮在一次交通事故中不幸失去了左耳,在接受移植手术后,他获得了神秘的老鼠权。良星不断制造假消息以为自己谋利。他与正直的女警察宋海燕王普西利亚(Sung Hoi-yan Pricilla Wong)发生冲突,导致他们两人失业。在她叔叔Ming Kwan-ngai KK KK 张的支持下,贺燕成为私人调查员。梁星被迫帮助慧妍探查她的调查活动,因为他利用神秘的力量去探明Ming Cheuk-kei Zoie Tam女神。金发的Tong Mei-fun Kamen Kong作为富有的家族继承人,Tsui Tsun-wai Daniel Chau 和她成为了敌人,受到残酷的骚扰。Mi-fun-fun 原谅徐伟,并主动提出帮助他陷入困境。梁星越来越傲慢,因为他用自己的权力来解决案子。与此同时,Hoi-yyan 突然地发现我本人的心力和心力。)

programme.title: Wo Jiao Zhang Si De
programme.desc: Set during the Chinese Communist Revolution, this historical drama follows the life of Zhang Side, a humble peasant from Sichuan who joined the Red Army. Rather than portraying him as an oversized hero, the series focuses on his quiet work ethic and selflessnessfrom surviving the Long March to serving as a guard in Yanan. In 1944, Zhang tragically dies when a charcoal kiln collapses, sacrificing his life to save a fellow soldier and leaving behind an enduring legacy of selfless service

programme.title: Blessing of Formosa
programme.desc: The beauty of folklore is all around us in Taiwan, but we often overlook it and fail to appreciate and feel it. The aim of this program is to promote the beauty of Taiwanese folklore and bring folklore to life. This program showcases folk culture regardless of race or religion, and presents travel information in a fun way, combining easy-to-understand folk culture knowledge with the mission of passing on folk culture. The audience can learn more about folk cultural products such as handicrafts, antiques, temple folklore, as well as short stories about the gods, and information about local tourism. It is an educational and entertaining way to travel and learn about folklore.

programme.title: Echoes Of The Thunder ((速战))
programme.desc: Two half-brothers, Nam and Fire, are top racing drivers. In a racing challenge with Japanese driver Kenji, Nam causes a young racing driver to be seriously injured and is depressed. Fire stands up for Nam and decides to compete with Kenji in an illegal street car race. Who will win the race? Can Nam finally bounce back? (南和火这两个半兄弟是顶尖的赛车手。 在与日本司机健二的比赛中,南导致一位年轻的赛车手严重受伤,情绪低落。 南和火代表南和南决定与健二在一场非法的街头赛车比赛中竞争。 谁能赢得比赛? 南终于能反弹吗?)

programme.title: The Exodus ((苍穹之法芙娜 EXODUS))
programme.desc: A low-ranking cop discovers a group of women, including his superior, Madam Fang and his wife, plotting to eliminate the world of men. (一个低级警察发现了一群妇女,包括他的上司方方女士和妻子,密谋消灭男人的世界。)

programme.title: Look for a Star ((游龙戏凤))
programme.desc: Sam is a charismatic tycoon who has been divorced three times. When he meets Milan, a cabaret dancer and croupier, they immediately fall in love. However, their romance faces challenges when he proposes a prenuptial agreement, putting their budding relationship at risk. (萨姆是一个魅力十足的大亨,离婚三次。 当他遇见了米兰(一个夜总会舞者兼保镖 ), 他们立刻坠入爱河。 然而,当他提出婚前协议时,他们的浪漫关系面临挑战,让她们开始建立的关系面临风险。)

programme.title: Mad Fate ((命案))
programme.desc: A Master fortune teller predicts that Tung, a born psychopath, will be imprisoned for murder and tries to change his fate. A veteran detective believes Tung is a psychopathic serial killer after witnessing him kill a cat, and pursues him relentlessly. Can the Master change Tungs mad fate? (一位总算算算师预测,天生的精神病患者董东将因谋杀而入狱,并试图改变他的命运。 一位经验丰富的侦探认为,在目睹通目睹他杀死一只猫并无情地追杀他之后,他就是精神病连环杀手。 大师能改变通斯的疯狂命运吗?)

programme.title: The Brotherhood Of Rebel ((扎职2：江湖陌路))
programme.desc: Chai, a triad member, helps his childhood friend Meow flee Hong Kong after discovering that Meow attempted to kill his triad boss. 17 years later, Chai becomes a key member of the triad. When he runs into Meow one day, he knows that his gang will kill Meow if they find him. Caught between triad and brotherhood, what will Chai choose? (三合会成员Chai在发现Meow试图杀害其三合会老板后帮助其童年朋友Meow逃离香港。 17年后,Chai成为三合会的关键成员。 有一天,当他跑到Meow时,他知道他的帮派会杀死Meow,如果他们找到他。 在三合会和兄弟会之间,Chai会选择什么?)

programme.title: Everything Is Unknown ((意外人生))
programme.desc: Pan Yi Ming receives his fathers will stating that he must attend his funeral at home to claim the huge inheritance. When he returns home, he encounters his ex-girlfriend, her husband Hua Qi and his daughter whom he has never met. When Pan discovers that his daughter is being abused by Hua, he vows to save her but eventually fall into their trap (潘仪明的父亲会收到父亲的来函,说他必须在家里参加葬礼,以获得巨大的遗产。当他回家时,他遇到了他的前女友、她的丈夫华琦和女儿,而他从未见过她们。 当潘仪明发现他的女儿被华婆虐待时,他发誓要救她,但最终会落入他们的陷阱。)

programme.title: Wild City ((野性新加坡))
programme.desc: A cop-turned-bar-owner befriends a drunken woman at closing hours and finds himself pursued by her former lover and the thugs he employs. The chase turns deadly when the bar owners deadbeat brother and a suitcase full of cash enter the picture. (当酒吧老板的死党兄弟和装满现金的手提箱进入照片中时,追逐就会变得致命。)

programme.title: Measure in Love ((他年她日))
programme.desc: A massive earthquake splits the world into two regions where time flows at different speeds. During a medical relief mission, student An Qing meets Shu Zai, and an extraordinary bond begins. Yet with every reunion, he ages rapidly while she remains unchanged, forcing them to confront a love challenged by time, distance, and fate. (一场大地震将世界分裂为两个时间以不同速度流动的区域。 在医疗救援任务中,安青学生与舒宰会面,并开始与众不同寻常的纽带。 然而,每次重聚,他都会在她没有变化的情况下迅速衰老,迫使他们面对时间、距离和命运挑战的爱情。)

programme.title: Raging Fire (愤怒的火)
programme.desc: As the police sets to arrest a drug lord, a team of masked thugs steals the drugs and murders the cops. Inspector Bong is devastated to see the aftermath of the carnage and soon discovers that the killers are led by Ngo, a former fellow cop who was forced into a life of crime by him. As the two men meet again, it is time to settle the score (当警察开始逮捕一名毒品主,一支面具暴徒偷走了毒品并杀害了警察.检查员邦被摧毁看到屠杀后果,很快发现杀手是由恩戈领导的,一位前警察被迫进入犯罪生活.)

programme.title: Good Game ((高手过招))
programme.desc: Several down-and-out individuals find a spark in esports. From a cybercaf to the competitive arena, they form team Happy Hour, battling rivals and lifes setbacks to reclaim a second chance. (从网络咖啡馆到竞技场,他们组成了“欢乐一小时”团队,与竞争对手和生活挫折抗争,以重获第二次机会。)

programme.title: Fly Me to the Moon ((但愿人长久))
programme.desc: New Hong Kong immigrants Yuan and her sister face identity crises, poverty, and their fathers drug addiction. Initially, the sisters attempt to appease him, but as they enter adolescence, they ultimately rebel and escape. Even as they separate from their father, Yuan finds his traits mirrored in her loved ones. (和她的妹妹面临身份危机,贫困和父亲的毒品成.最初,姐妹试图安抚他,但当他们进入青春期时,他们最终叛乱并逃离.即使他们与父亲分开,也发现他的特征在她亲人中反映.)

programme.title: Shock Wave (冲击波)
programme.desc: Bomb specialist Cheung Choi San sets out to capture a wanted criminal called Blast. However, will he be able to do it in time before Blast kills hundreds of citizens inside Hong Kongs busiest Cross Harbour Tunnel and destroys everything in his quest for revenge? (炸弹专家张崔桑准备逮捕一个叫爆炸犯的通缉犯。 但是,他能否在爆炸杀死香港最繁忙的横渡港隧道中的数百名公民并摧毁他为复仇而作的一切之前及时这样做?)

programme.title: My Wife is a Gambling Maestro ((我的老婆是赌圣))
programme.desc: Natalie Yao Meng stars as the gambling queen, Ying Ying, who is a contender for the Asian God of Gamblers competition. But before the competition she is betrayed by her fianc and left for dead. Rescued by a young man called Gerrard, who suffering from amnesia, Ying Ying, must recover in time to compete in the big event! (娜塔莉·姚孟星(Natalie Yao Meng Stars)作为赌王皇后,英英(Ying Ying)是亚洲赌神竞赛的对手。 但在比赛之前,她被未婚夫背叛,然后被送去死。 一个名叫Gerrard的年轻人,他患有失忆症,英英英(Ying Ying Ying)必须及时康复才能在大赛中竞争!)

programme.title: Time Still Turns the Pages ((年少日记))
programme.desc: High school teacher Cheng recalls his violent childhood memories when he finds an anonymous suicide note in the classroom. While he has to prevent the tragedy involving a suicidal student from happening, he also has to face a series of family problems with his wife wanting to divorce him and his fathers serious illness. (高中老师程在课堂上发现匿名自杀笔记时回忆起他暴力的童年记忆。 虽然他必须防止自杀学生的悲剧发生,但他也必须面对一系列家庭问题,他的妻子要与他离婚,他的父亲要重病。)

programme.title: The Monkey King ((美猴王))
programme.desc: After Goddess Nuwa sacrifices herself to save the mortal world, Monkey King comes into being from one of her crystals. Powerful and uncontrollable, Monkey King challenges the Jade Emperor and causes an uproar in heaven, unwittingly creating an opportunity for the wicked Buffalo Demon King to wage war in heaven. (努瓦女神为了拯救凡人世界而牺牲自己之后,猴子王从她的水晶中诞生。 强大和无法控制的猴子王挑战玉帝,在天堂制造暴怒,无意中为邪恶的水牛妖王创造了在天堂发动战争的机会。)

programme.title: Detrimental ((见怪))
programme.desc: You Ji Ren is a blind man who works at a factory on an outlying island. When the factory is cut off from the outside world by a hurricane one day, a monster appears and turns whoever sees it into black shadows. As You cannot see the monster, he is able to help his other co-workers escape safely and fight to kill the monster. (你智廉是个盲人,他在一个外岛的工厂工作。当工厂有一天被飓风与外界隔绝时,一个怪物出现,把任何人看到它变成黑影。你看不到怪物,他能够帮助其他同事安全逃脱,并战斗杀死怪物。)

programme.title: The Moon Thieves ((从地球到月球 Thieves))
programme.desc: A crooked watch dealer assembles a daring crew - a thief, an explosive expert, a lock breaker and a watch connoisseur - to steal three luxury watches in Tokyo. Their mission takes an unexpected turn when they discover the legendary Moonwatch. Pursued by the yakuza, the team must unite to navigate the chaos and pull off their high-stakes heist. (一个邪恶的钟表经销商聚集了一个胆大妄为的团队 — — 一个小偷、爆炸专家、断锁者和钟表经纪人 — — 来在东京偷三个奢侈品手表。当他们发现传奇的月表时,他们的任务发生了意外的转折。在黑帮的追赶下,团队必须团结起来,以克服混乱,完成他们高额抢掠。)

programme.title: The Spirit of the Sword ((浣花洗剑录))
programme.desc: Water Clan Chief is severely wounded by a samurai killer shortly before the annual duel at Tai Lake. He sends his brother Bao Yu on a long journey to find an antidote for him. On the way, Bao Yu encounters Little Princess and falls in love with her, not knowing that she is hiding a secret plot (水族首领在大湖一年一度的决斗前不久,被一名武士杀手严重打伤,他派哥哥宝羽远途寻找解药。 在路上,宝玉遇到了小公主,爱上了她,不知道她隐藏了一个秘密阴谋。)

programme.title: The Savage Five ((五虎将))
programme.desc: A group of bandits flees with a stolen safe to a village where they oppress the villagers and force the blacksmith Wei to unlock the safe. Wei refuses and flees to report to officials, while heroes of the town emerge to fight the bandits. (一群强盗带着被盗的安全柜逃到一个村庄,在那里他们压迫村民,并迫使铁匠威解锁安全柜. 威拒绝并逃离,向官员报告,而城市的英雄们出现在战斗强盗.)

programme.title: New Tales of the Flying Fox ((新飞狐外传))
programme.desc: In a great rendition of The Silver Fox and Legend of the Fox comes this exciting adventure, where the only thing between the clan leaders and certain death is Hui Ying-hung. (在银狐和传奇传奇的传说 伟大的传说中 福狐来了这个激动人心的冒险)

programme.title: Hex vs Witchcraft ((邪斗邪))
programme.desc: A compulsive gambler with bad luck owes money to a violent gangster boss and trades his wife as down payment, causing her to leave him. As he decides to kill himself, a mysterious old man offers him a proposal to marry the ghost of his dead daughter in exchange for cash and an expensive apartment. (一个有不良运气的强迫博者欠钱一个暴力的帮派老板,他把他的妻子作为首付,让她离开他.)

programme.title: The Big Sting ((鬼马神偷))
programme.desc: Three buddies find a rare artifact known as the Double-Faced God but are poisoned by Lady Wu who steals the treasure from them. Before they die, they get their wives to promise to train their children to take back what is rightfully theirs. These kids grow up to exact a vengeance that turns out to be more hilarious than horrific in this comedy. (三个朋友发现一个罕见的古物,被称为双面神,但被夫人毒害,她偷了宝藏.在他们死之前,他们让他们的妻子承诺训练他们的孩子,)

programme.title: Dawn Will Come ((魂断奈何天))
programme.desc: Liang Cai drugged the beautiful Qiu Rong and raped her, but promised to marry her after getting his parents consent. Since then, there is no news of his proposal and Qiu Rong confronts Liang Cai when she finds herself pregnant. This is when she discovers that he has already married a rich noble girl and even plans to kill her (梁才给美丽的邱荣下了药,强奸了她,但答应在得到父母同意后娶她。此后,没有关于他求婚的消息,而邱荣在发现自己怀孕时与梁才对质。这时,她发现他已经娶了一个高贵的富裕女孩,甚至计划杀害她。)

programme.title: Two Champions of Shaolin ((少林与武当))
programme.desc: Set in the Qing Dynasty, the Shaolin clan wants to overthrow Qing and restore the Ming Dynasty, while the Wudang clan is backed by the Qing government. The two renowned clans eventually set themselves up against each other, and a series of vicious fighting has just begun (在清朝中,少林氏族想推翻清清,恢复明朝,而武当族则得到清政府的支持。 两大知名氏族最终相互对立,一系列恶战刚刚开始。)

programme.title: Spring Blossoms ((新一剪梅))
programme.desc: Some of Shaw Brothers biggest female stars of the 1970s share the screen in this tale of young love and interfering parents, starring Lily Li, Shu Pei Pei and Essie Lin Chia. (Shaw Brothers中一些1970年代最大的女性明星 分享了这个年轻爱情和干扰父母的故事 主角是Lily Li、Shu Pei Pei和Essie Lin Chia。)

programme.title: The Magnificent Trio ((边城三侠))
programme.desc: A group of farmers who are being oppressed by the local magistrates kidnap one of the magistrates daughter in the hope of being heard by the authorities. A wandering swordsman offers his help and aiding him are two fighters who have both switched sides from being the oppressors to the oppressed. The trio fight back against the magistrates! (一群农民被当地地方法官压迫,他们绑架了一名地方法官的女儿,希望当局听取他们的意见。 一个流浪的剑客向他伸出援手,帮助他。 两名战士从压迫者转向被压迫者。 三重战者反击地方法官。)

programme.title: Fast Fingers ((梁上君子))
programme.desc: After his release from prison, Uncle Bill returns to make a fortune with his past thieving partners. They continue to prey on the unsuspecting public, but are closely watched by the upright police chief, who happens to be the boyfriend of one of Uncle Bills nieces! (比尔叔叔从监狱获释后,回来与过去的伙伴们一起发财。 他们继续利用那些不知情的公众,但受到正直的警察局长的密切监视,他恰好是比尔斯叔叔侄女之一的男朋友!)

programme.title: Angel with the Iron Fists ((铁观音))
programme.desc: Lo Wei directs and stars as the chief detective in this gripping thriller playing alongside Lily Ho, who excels in the role of an undercover avenger that can fight as well as she flirts! Caught between the crime bosses known as Baldhead and Black Widow, she only has four choices: punch, kick, shoot or bombard with explosives! (和Lily Ho一起玩的这个握手的刺激片的首席侦探Lo Wei导演和明星们。 她擅长于一个既能打又能调情的卧底复仇者的角色!)

programme.title: The Last Tempest ((瀛台泣血))
programme.desc: This sequel to The Empress Dowager continues the tale of Emperor Guangxu and Empress Dowager Cixi. Despite Guangxus enthronement, his ability to rule effectively is overshadowed by the ever-present power of Cixi. When his attempts to reform the Imperial system are thwarted by the Empress Dowager, Guangxu attempts to curb her power. (多华王后继此事件之后,广州皇帝和多瓦赫王后仍继续传说光苏和西西皇后的故事。 尽管广州皇帝登上皇宫,但西西始终存在的势力掩盖了他有效统治的能力。 当他改革帝国体制的尝试被多瓦高太后挫败时,广州试图扼制她的权力。)

programme.title: The Hidden Power Of Dragon Sabre ((魔殿屠龙))
programme.desc: Defeated villain Sung Ching Shu returns and starts a reign of terror, trapping a beautiful Mongolian Princess and mastering the yin and yang combination to become almost invincible. Only two swords held by two great swordsmen can stand in his way! (被打败的恶棍成正舒返回,开始恐怖统治,困住一个美丽的蒙古公主,掌握阴阳结合,几乎无法战胜。 只有两把剑能挡住他的路!)

programme.title: Torrent Of Desire ((欲焰狂流))
programme.desc: Rich playboy David is a drunk until he falls in love with a fashion model Dan Feng and marries her. Davids sister Mona is in love with his best friend Han Ming, who rejected her as he secretly loves Dan Feng as well. Out of jealousy and hatred, Mona lies to David about a fake affair between Han Ming and Dan Feng... (富裕的玩家戴维是一个醉酒者,直到他爱上了时尚模特丹·芬,并嫁给了她.戴维的妹妹莫娜爱上了他的最好朋友汉明,他拒绝了她,因为他秘密地爱丹·芬.)

programme.title: Lion VS Lion ((杀手的智力：狮子VS鬣狗))
programme.desc: The traditional lion dance has never looked so good as in Lion VS Lion which captures the most impressive sequences of lion dancing on film. Besides being loaded with enjoyable martial arts chicanery, film historians can revel because its also the first film that clearly demonstrates the intricacies and differences between the traditional Northern and Southern lion dancing techniques. The Five Venom alumnus and Chang Cheh discovery, Lo Meng, teams up with Liu Chia-liang protege Wang Yu, as they inadvertently turn from vagabond kung-fu school operators into anti-Ching, patriotic fighters. (传统的狮子舞蹈从未像狮子VS狮子那样好过。 狮子VS狮子在电影中捕捉了最令人印象深刻的狮子舞蹈系列。 电影史学家除了被装满了令人愉快的武术奇技外,还可以感到振奋,因为它也是第一部清楚显示传统北部和南部狮子舞蹈技术之间的复杂和差异的电影。 南和北部狮子舞蹈技术的5个Venom校友和陈哲发现组织,Lo Meng,与刘志良一郎的王羽联手,他们无意中从流浪的武功学校操作者转变为反清、爱国战士。)

programme.title: The Crazy Bumpkins ((阿牛出獄記))
programme.desc: This side-splitting comedy sees naive Ah Niu headed to Hong Kong, where he is repeatedly exploited and taken advantage of, and eventually finds himself arrested and imprisoned! Can he survive difficult times and finally overcome adversity? (这场片面的喜剧看到天真阿牛来到香港,在那里他一再被剥削和利用,最终被捕入狱! 他能度过艰难的时光,克服逆境吗?)

programme.title: Opium And The Kung-Fu Master ((洪拳大师))
programme.desc: Tie Qiao San, head of the Ten Guangdong Tigers, is an honourable master with many disciples. As opium becomes popular among the nobles, Tie starts taking it and gradually harms his body. When an opium houses owner defeats Tie in a fight and he is only saved from being killed by his disciple, Tie vows to quit opium and get back on his feet. (泰广东虎队长铁桥三是一位有众多门徒的光荣大师。 随着鸦片在贵族中越来越受欢迎,铁桥开始吸食鸦片并逐渐伤害他的身体。 当鸦片屋主在战斗中击败铁桥,他只能免于被门徒杀害时,铁桥发誓戒除鸦片并重新站起来。)

programme.title: Return of the Phoenix ((凤还巢))
programme.desc: An imperial minister Cheng betroths his pretty younger daughter, Ye, to his friends son, Mu. His wife however, refuses to let Ye marry before her elder daughter Yan, who is ugly and undesirable. Yan is asked to pretend as Ye to meet Mu but scares him away. A rich guy who likes Ye meanwhile pretends as Mu to attend the wedding... (一位帝国大臣郑正春向朋友的儿子穆。 他的妻子拒绝让叶欣在她丑陋和不受欢迎的大女儿Yan面前结婚。 杨奉命假装是叶相见,但他却吓跑他。 一位喜欢叶爱的有钱人却假装是穆爱参加婚礼。)

programme.title: King Cat ((小明和王猫))
programme.desc: The son of the imperial teacher is beheaded by Justice Bao for corruption. Infuriated, the teacher hires assassins to kill Bao, who is saved by Zhan Zhao. Meanwhile, a royal treasure is stolen while a murder takes place. Bao is ordered to solve the case in ten days and Zhan quickly sets off to investigate. Will they solve the case in time? (拜大法官以贪污罪将帝国教父之子斩首。 愤怒的是,老师雇用刺客去杀害被钱赵救活的宝,同时,在谋杀发生时,王室宝藏被盗。 宝奉命十天后破案,张大法官迅速着手调查。 他们能及时破案吗?)

programme.desc: Two friends, Anu and Arjun, marry, but misunderstandings complicate their life, leading to a divorce.

programme.desc: A man rescues four friends and gives them shelter in his home. However, they soon realise that the mans wife is actually a ghost and decide to help him.

programme.desc: Bharath, a cop, turns MLA and director to bring down a don who attacked his father. Love and danger follow as he hunts the criminal from Mumbai to Spain.

programme.desc: A newlywed couples lives are hilariously upended when their lucky pet fish, Kattappa, goes missing, leading to unforeseen consequences and dark comedic situations.

programme.desc: Tripura, whose dreams turn into reality, is taken to Hyderabad for treatment. She falls in love with and marries her doctor, whom she, one day, dreams of killing.

Weird and wonderful, these unsung heroes are Wildest New Zealands Creepiest Crawlies. programme.title: New Kids In The Wild ((热血新仔))

programme.desc: 一杯中式的茶，背後有著無窮的學問，不同的茶取決於發酵的程度，亦不是每種茶也是水滾茶靚今集杏林在線，分別到訪茶樓和茶莊，了解茶的學問茶莊老闆Michael認為喝茶也可以養生，還可以修身，喝茶亦不是越貴越好茶莊老闆Michael:輕輕嚐一口，經過嘴牙肉後才吞，吞下去後再呼氣，飲茶讓我心理正常紓緩營養師指茶葉內含有兒茶素等抗氧化物質，有機會可以幫助預防慢性疾病，甚至減慢認知能力下降，但茶亦含有咖啡因和茶鹼等提神成分，容易傷胃，甚至讓人出現心悸，對咖啡因會敏感的人士，飲用抹茶更要小心聖方濟各大學余兆麒健康科學院助理教授曾佩欣：抹茶其實是將原片茶葉磨成粉，我們飲用的時候，其實將茶葉也會一同飲用的，所以它裡面茶葉的成分便會比較多，包括那些茶多酚咖啡因所以它如果是對咖啡因會敏感的人，其實飲用那些抹茶，也會更容易有心悸的情況出現團隊走訪本地農場，記錄農夫從採茶到炒茶的過程中醫師認為不同的茶有其偏性，應按自己身體情況而選擇
